questions.question: Use the check-supplier-invoice skill: can Zava Matériaux's invoice FA-2026-0217 be paid as it stands?

answer.text:
No — for chantier **Moreau**, Zava Matériaux invoice **FA-2026-0217** should **not be paid as it stands**: it bills **10 palettes** of blocks, but the delivery note records **“reçu 8 pal.”** and a reservation **“2 palettes manquantes”** (OCR), so receipt is incomplete for a billed line.[1][2]

The order/invoice tracking otherwise matches the invoice amount: **BC-2026-012** is shown as **Commandé HT 1484.8** and **Facturé HT 1484.8**, with status “Livré le 13/03/2026, facture FA-2026-0217”.[3] The invoice itself references **BC-2026-012**, **BL-2026-0391 du 13/03/2026**, and totals **1,484.80 € HT / 1,781.76 € TTC**, due **30/04/2026**.[1]  
Recommended action: put the invoice on hold pending a corrected invoice/credit note or proof of delivery of the 2 missing pallets.[1][2]

answer.text:
Prepared for the **Moreau chantier**: **site meeting no. 4 is scheduled for 7 April 2026 at 08:30 on site** [1].  
As of the current previous meeting minutes, the meeting should focus on closing the action log from meeting no. 3, coordinating the 7–10 April works, and confirming the planning update [1][2][3].

## Proposed attendees / distribution check

Expected participants from the previous meeting record were Séverine Moreau, Aymeric Moreau, Inès Roux, Mathis Ancelin and Damien Pradère, with Bertrand Sauzède excused but on distribution, and Erwan Gouzelin also on distribution [2].

## Agenda for meeting no. 4

1. **Validate the previous action log before starting new decisions.**  
   Check whether Inès Roux updated planning PLN-2026-003 to indice B by 27/03/2026, whether Bertrand Sauzède verified invoice FA-2026-0217 against the 13/03/2026 delivery note before payment by 31/03/2026, whether Damien Pradère confirmed the 07/04/2026 electrical intervention by 31/03/2026, and whether the Moreau family emptied the kitchen furniture by 03/04/2026 [3].

2. **Coordinate works starting on 07/04/2026.**  
   The electrical conduit run for the extension is planned from 07/04 to 10/04/2026, and the planning line for “Électricité 1er œuvre” also lists Adatum Électricité from 2026-04-07 to 2026-04-10 [4][5].  
   The temporary closure of the bay openings with wooden panels is planned on 07/04/2026 so that extension insulation can start from 13/04/2026 [6].  
   The kitchen renovation was advanced to 07/04–10/04/2026 for demolition and plumbing, with client agreement [7].

3. **Resolve the planning discrepancy on the kitchen sequence.**  
   Planning indice A still listed “Cuisine : dépose et plomberie” from 2026-04-27 to 2026-04-30, while meeting no. 3 states that the same kitchen demolition/plumbing work was advanced to 07/04–10/04/2026 with client agreement [8][7].  
   The meeting should therefore confirm that planning PLN-2026-003 indice B has been issued and that all affected trades are working from the advanced dates [3][7][8].

4. **Check readiness for insulation after 13/04/2026.**  
   The meeting should confirm that the 07/04 bay-closure action is sufficient for the insulation and plasterboard sequence scheduled from 2026-04-13 to 2026-04-24 [6][9].

## Decisions to obtain in the meeting minutes

- Confirm whether the 07/04–10/04 electrical intervention is mobilised, accessible and coordinated with the kitchen works [4][5][7].  
- Confirm whether the kitchen was cleared before the 03/04/2026 deadline and is ready for the advanced demolition/plumbing work [3][7].  
- Confirm whether planning PLN-2026-003 indice B supersedes the indice A kitchen dates, because indice A still shows kitchen work on 27/04–30/04 while meeting no. 3 advances it to 07/04–10/04 [3][7][8].  
- Confirm that the bay closures on 07/04 allow insulation to start on 13/04 as planned [6][9].

questions.question: VanArsdel Menuiseries reports a shortage of aluminium profiles: which chantiers does it hit, and which réception dates are at risk?

- **École de Montferrine** is not shown as hit in the retrieved evidence: VanArsdel says aluminium-joinery deliveries planned from **01/07/2026** onward are “not concerned” at that stage, and the Montferrine VanArsdel delivery is scheduled for **06/07/2026**.[8][9]
